source.method: Native-pixel assembly of public _BASE and A-AREA-CAFM tiles.

limitations: Room 3010 is directly labeled in the 2024 plan. Its walls are manually traced; small columns and door recesses are simplified.

Registration mirrors the source y axis to match the inherited meter frame. Four independent corner checks include the adjacent 3000A room; the source north arrow contradicts the inherited campus orientation, so campus placement is omitted and true north remains unknown.
The source prints 871 square feet while the Facilities room inventory lists 866. Neither area was used to force the room dimensions.
The published FIS raster may lag current CAD or alterations.
The floor remains partial; one additional local floor patch follows room 3010 and does not claim a complete floor plate.
Fourth-floor schedule key 4124 remains unplaced: the acquired 2016 drawing labels separate 4124A and 4124B rooms, and no verified schedule crosswalk was found.
